note: 산문 설명만으로는 프로파일이 매 실행 무시된다. 이 파일이 단일 출처이며 scripts/style_profile.py 가 슬라이드 역할에 맞는 스타일 변형과 기준 이미지를 주입한다.

forest-sand.label: 포레스트·샌드
forest-sand.use: 환경·지역·식품. 초록이 실제 맥락일 때만 선택

toss-data-unified.label: Toss 3D + 데이터 리포트 통합
toss-data-unified.summary: 개념·제품은 작은 Toss형 3D 씬, 기능·단계는 시맨틱 아이콘, 설문·KPI·통계는 정밀한 데이터 에디토리얼로 자동 전환하는 전역 기본값.

toss-3d.label: Toss형 3D 씬
toss-3d.promptBlock:
★★ VARIANT — TOSS 3D SCENE:
Use this for covers, concepts, products, services, processes, journeys and
roadmaps. Keep the white editorial base and Pretendard-style Korean gothic type.
Use one small, premium 3D isometric or clay object group that explains the
message. Tuck it into a corner or one side with generous whitespace.
Use soft matte materials, broad faint shadows and restrained same-hue tints.
The illustration must be semantically bound to the claim. Never enlarge a
small icon into a hero scene. NO dashboard composition unless the slide is
actually data-heavy. NO generic decorative icons or meaningless geometry.

icon-editorial.label: 시맨틱 아이콘 에디토리얼
icon-editorial.promptBlock:
★★ VARIANT — SEMANTIC ICON EDITORIAL:
The validated Data Editorial pages are the visual master. Icons are tiny labels
inside an editorial information layout; they NEVER determine the layout.
Use this for 3–6 repeated features, stages, roles, requirements or benefits.
Build a conclusion-led headline with a light/regular premise and bold finding
on the same baseline. Keep the title modest and the upper 25% calm. Start the
body between 28% and 34% of slide height and make the last meaningful body edge
land between 78% and 84%. A structural page ending above 68% is under-filled.
Choose exactly one recipe by content:
- PROCESS (5 stages): one continuous rail or baseline with five small icon nodes,
  no individual cards. Enlarge only the active stage label, not its container.
- ROADMAP (4 periods): NEVER use a straight timeline or one horizontal period
  line. Build four staggered editorial steps rising from lower-left to upper-right.
  Each step is a flat phase slab with a large week marker, short title and tiny
  icon. Use pale neutral fills and one accent step; no equal cards or boxes.
- MODULES (4 capabilities): one 42% featured module plus three compact stacked
  rows, or one continuous panel split by 1px rules. Never a 2x2 card grid.
Every icon shares one thin stroke, optical size and accent treatment, occupying
less than 6% of slide height. Surfaces are near-white and almost borderless.
Highlight through number, type weight, icon colour or a pale tint, NEVER a blue
outline. NO equal repeated cards, dashboard tile grid, floating panels, thick
connectors, emoji, icon-font glyphs, oversized icons, hero 3D object, decorative
filler or mixed icon families.

data-editorial.label: 데이터 리포트 에디토리얼
data-editorial.promptBlock:
★★ VARIANT — DATA REPORT EDITORIAL:
Use this for surveys, KPI, metrics, statistics, distributions, tables and
performance evidence. Data is the visual. Do not add a 3D illustration.
Use a conclusion-led headline with a light premise and bold finding on the same
baseline. Structural content starts between 28% and 34% of slide height and its
last meaningful edge lands between 78% and 84%; ending above 68% is under-filled.
Use precise bars, restrained donuts, direct labels, 1px rules and short evidence
annotations. Highlight only the decisive 1–2 values with the accent and a lighter
same-hue tint; keep all other marks charcoal or cool grey.
For BAR REPORTS, normalize the largest bar to 100% of the plot width; never use
the raw percentage as CSS width. Give the bar plot 68% and KPI summaries 28% of
the content zone with a 4% gap. Their top and bottom edges should carry equal
visual weight. Put annotations directly below the plot, never floating between
chart and KPI cards.
For TABLES, preserve this exact report grammar: one solid accent-blue header
band with white labels; alternating white and very light cool-grey body rows;
flat square corners; generous row height; faint 1px column separators; no outer
card, no row cards, no shadow. Left-align descriptive columns and center a short
output/status column. Recommended three-column proportion is 28% / 52% / 20%.
Use one of the validated compositions shown in the attached references:
KPI triad plus interpretation, metadata plus donut plus distributions, or
65/35 bars plus summary KPI cards. Red is allowed only for a real warning or gap.
NO full-background gradient, neon glow, generic icons or oversized dashboard tiles.

toss-data-unified.antiSlopPrompt:
★★ EDITORIAL SURFACE RULE:
Do not place ordinary text inside a large pale-grey or pale-accent rectangular card merely to occupy space. Do not use a top accent stroke attached to a washed-out card, a giant empty panel with metadata pushed to its bottom, or repeated soft cards as the default grammar. These are generic AI-slide patterns. Prefer naked typography on the canvas, asymmetric columns, hairline dividers, aligned metadata strips, and one intentional visual anchor. A container is allowed only when it encodes a real semantic boundary such as a table, warning, selected module, or image crop.
toss-data-unified.headlinePrompt:
★★ HEADLINE LANGUAGE RULE:
Write headlines as direct editorial labels, not motivational copy. For schedules, breaks, agendas, instructions and status pages, use a concise noun phrase or time-plus-action format. Do not force the light-premise plus bold-conclusion sentence pattern onto operational pages. Avoid automatic endings such as 합니다/입니다 when a shorter label works. Avoid generic AI rhetoric such as '~를 넘어/~을 넘어', '~가 아니라', '함께 만듭니다', '다시 시작합니다', '연결됩니다', or '새로운 가능성'. Preserve those phrases only when the user supplied them verbatim. Prefer examples like '15분 휴식 · 10:25 팀별 활동 재개', '이번 주 실행 항목', and '운영 기준 설계'.
toss-data-unified.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — TOSS 3D + ICON + DATA EDITORIAL UNIFIED:
Maintain one deck identity across all three variants: pure or near-white canvas,
Pretendard-style Korean gothic typography, charcoal text, one supplied accent,
small section eyebrow, wide margins, fine dividers and restrained soft shadows.
The validated Data Editorial pages define the master typography, card scale and
whitespace. Toss 3D and icons must adapt to that system, not replace it.
For HTML structural pages, begin the body at 28–34% of slide height and end its
last meaningful visual edge at 78–84%. Reserve only 10–14% for the footer band;
do not leave an empty lower quarter. Covers and closing slides are exceptions.
Route each slide by information role. Conceptual slides use Toss 3D; repeated
features, stages and checklists use Semantic Icon Editorial; data-heavy slides
use Data Editorial. Do not mix a 3D hero, an icon grid and a dense chart on the
same slide. Use modest report headlines and compact almost-borderless cards.
Typography, accent and footer remain consistent across the deck.

modern-flat.label: 모던 플랫 (Toss/Naver flat)
modern-flat.summary: 밝고 친근한 정보 전달. 스타트업 IR·SaaS·이커머스·데이터 성과·심사 발표에 적합.

typography.headline: 큰 볼드 고딕, 다만 modest 스케일

modern-flat.numbers: 큰 볼드 숫자로 핵심 수치 하나만
modern-flat.accentColorPolicy: 브랜드색을 파라미터로 받는다. 레퍼런스가 블루여도 브랜드색을 강제하고 임의 블루를 금지한다.
modern-flat.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — MODERN FLAT (Toss/Naver flat):
Bright clean editorial-tech look. White or very light warm-grey background.
Pretendard-style Korean gothic typeface — NEVER serif/myeongjo.
One message per slide. Generous airy whitespace, low information density.
Soft rounded cards and pill shapes. Thin light-grey divider rules.
Small English eyebrow label above a modest bold gothic headline.
One large bold number when a metric matters.
3D isometric / clay illustration and flat icons, rendered SMALL and tucked
into a corner — never large or heavy. Every illustration must be semantically
bound to the slide message (customer=people/connection, strategy=growth
arrow/steps, roadmap=path/milestones, results=rising chart, brand=brand motif).
NO generic decorative icons, NO meaningless geometric filler.
REFINED & SMALL: modest headline, small tucked illustration, generous airy
whitespace, NOT big/heavy/crowded.

data-report-editorial.label: 데이터 리포트 에디토리얼
data-report-editorial.summary: 한국형 트렌드·설문·컨설팅 보고서. 큰 결론형 헤드라인, 정밀한 차트, 절제된 KPI 카드에 적합.

typography.headline: 한 줄 안에서 전제는 Light 또는 Regular, 핵심 결론은 Bold
typography.eyebrow: 작은 영문·숫자 섹션 라벨, 넓은 자간
typography.body: 짧은 해석문은 Medium, 근거 본문은 작은 Regular

surface.cards: 흰색 또는 아주 옅은 쿨그레이, 작은 라운드, 넓고 흐린 그림자
surface.density: 중간. 데이터는 촘촘하지만 장식은 거의 없음

colour.accent: 브랜드 강조색과 그 밝은 틴트로 만든 짧은 2-stop tonal gradient
colour.status: 경고·격차 설명에만 작은 적색 주석 허용

layoutRecipes.thesis-bars: 상단 25% 결론형 헤드라인, 좌측 65% 가로 막대와 주석, 우측 35% 요약 KPI 카드 2개
layoutRecipes.kpi-triad: 상단 중앙 헤드라인과 서브, 중단 동일 너비 KPI 3개, 하단 좌측 해석문과 근거 본문
layoutRecipes.respondent-overview: 좌측 메타데이터 패널, 중앙 조직 규모 도넛, 우측 직급·직무 가로 막대 2단
layoutRecipes.dashboard-grid: 하나의 바깥 테두리 안에서 차트 구역을 1px 선으로 분할하고 제목은 각 구역 좌상단에 정렬

chartGrammar.bars: 최댓값을 plot 폭 100%로 정규화하고 나머지를 비례 배율로 그린다. raw 백분율을 CSS 폭으로 쓰지 않는다. plot 68%·KPI 28%·간격 4%, 양쪽 시각 높이를 맞춘다. 핵심 1~2개만 tonal gradient, 나머지는 연한 회색. 값은 막대 끝 안쪽에 정렬
chartGrammar.donut: 3개 이하 조각, 가장 중요한 조각만 진한 강조색, 라벨은 조각 안에 직접 표기
chartGrammar.annotation: 얇은 직각 connector와 짧은 한두 줄 주석. 경고일 때만 적색
chartGrammar.summaryCards: 큰 수치, 짧은 명사형 캡션, 아이콘 없이 수치 중심
chartGrammar.table: 브랜드 블루 헤더+흰 글자, 흰색/옅은 쿨그레이 지브라 행, 각진 모서리, 1px 열 구분선, 28/52/20 열 비율, 외곽 카드와 그림자 없음

data-report-editorial.accentColorPolicy: 지정한 브랜드색을 진한 끝점으로 쓰고 같은 hue의 밝은 틴트를 만든다. 적색은 경고 의미가 있을 때만 예외로 쓴다.
data-report-editorial.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — DATA REPORT EDITORIAL:
Premium Korean research-report layout on a pure white 16:9 canvas.
Pretendard-style Korean gothic typeface — NEVER serif/myeongjo.
Build a conclusion-led headline: light/regular premise and bold finding on the
same baseline. Keep a small section eyebrow above it with generous tracking.
Use a strict left grid and wide outer margins. Start the body at 28–34% and end
the last meaningful visual edge at 78–84% of slide height. Keep the footer band
to 10–14%; an empty lower quarter is a layout failure.
Data is the visual: precise horizontal bars, a restrained donut, fine 1px
rules, direct labels and short evidence annotations. No decorative illustration.
For bar reports, normalize the largest bar to the full plot width and scale all
other bars against it. Never map a raw 31% value to only 31% of the available
plot. Reserve 68% for bars and 28% for KPI summaries with a 4% gap; keep both
columns equal in visual height and place annotations immediately under the plot.
For tables, use one solid accent-blue header band with white labels, alternating
white and very light cool-grey rows, flat square corners, generous row height
and faint 1px column separators. Never wrap a table in a card and never turn
rows into rounded cards. Use 28% / 52% / 20% for a three-column report table;
left-align descriptions and center a short output/status column.
Highlight only the decisive 1–2 values. Use the supplied accent colour as the
dark endpoint and derive one lighter same-hue tint for a short tonal gradient.
All other marks use charcoal and three cool-grey levels. A small red annotation
is allowed only for a genuine warning, gap or negative finding.
Cards are white or near-white with small corners and a broad, very faint shadow.
Prefer asymmetric report compositions: 65/35 chart + KPI cards, KPI triad above
an interpretation block, or metadata + donut + two stacked distributions.
Keep footer metadata tiny and aligned to the bottom-right.
NO full-background gradient, NO neon glow, NO 3D/clay illustration, NO generic
icons, NO thick borders, NO oversized rounded dashboard tiles.

paper-serif.label: 페이퍼화이트 명조

illustration.kind: 실물 사진 크게, 선택적 수묵/잉크 모티프

paper-serif.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — PAPER SERIF:
Paper-white background, refined Korean serif (myeongjo) typography,
minimal composition with a single accent colour, thin hairline rules,
optional ink/sumi motif. Large real photography.
Calm, premium, generous negative space.

swiss-grid.label: 스위스 그리드
swiss-grid.summary: 검정 타이포그래피, 강한 좌측 정렬, 빨간 구조선으로 만드는 정밀한 정보 포스터.
swiss-grid.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — SWISS GRID:
Use a white canvas, strict asymmetric modular grid, black typography and one red or cobalt accent. Use large direct noun-phrase headlines, visible baseline logic, square geometry and thin black rules. Prefer numbered sections, cropped alignment and strong left edges. No soft cards, no gradients, no clay decoration, no centered symmetry.

warm-editorial.label: 웜 에디토리얼
warm-editorial.summary: 아이보리 바탕, 코럴·버건디 강조, 잡지형 비대칭 조판.
warm-editorial.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — WARM EDITORIAL:
Use an ivory paper canvas, warm charcoal text, restrained coral or burgundy accent and editorial magazine spacing. Build asymmetric text columns, large cropped photography or one material object, hairline rules and compact captions. Keep Korean body text sans-serif and precise. No generic pastel cards, no tech blue default, no dashboard grid.

technical-blueprint.label: 테크니컬 블루프린트
technical-blueprint.summary: 아이스 화이트 바탕, 네이비·시안, 구조도와 번호 체계를 강조.
technical-blueprint.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — TECHNICAL BLUEPRINT:
Use an ice-white canvas with navy structure colour and sparse cyan signal marks. Emphasize topology, labels, coordinates, numbered systems and fine technical rules. Use square frames only for real diagrams or tables. Keep large areas open but anchor every zone to a grid. No neon HUD, no dark sci-fi dashboard, no decorative circuitry.

photo-documentary.label: 포토 다큐멘터리
photo-documentary.summary: 실제 사진을 크게 쓰고 캡션·근거·문장만 절제해 얹는 증거 중심 구성.
photo-documentary.promptBlock:
★★ STYLE PROFILE — PHOTO DOCUMENTARY:
Use one large evidence photograph as the visual owner. Keep typography restrained, captions factual and metadata aligned like a documentary spread. Use white margins, black text and one muted accent sampled from the project palette. Never cover faces or evidence. No stock-photo collage, no floating cards, no 3D object when a real photo exists.
